## WorkerThreadInit class

Base class for worker thread implementations. Handles communication with the main thread and provides RPC functionality.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class WorkerThreadInit 
```

## Remarks

Extend this class when defining worker thread behavior. Uses `parentPort` for messaging with main thread. Constructor automatically signals readiness to main thread.

## Example


```typescript
import { WorkerThreadInit, WorkerThreadExport, log } from "gramstax";

class Worker extends WorkerThreadInit {
  constructor() {
    super(); // Required - signals ready to main thread
    log.info(`Worker ${this.id} started`);
  }

  mtdProcess(data: any) {
    return { processed: data };
  }
}

export const MyWorker = WorkerThreadExport.init({
  path: __filename,
  WTInit: Worker,
});
```
